programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Macbeth returns from his war expedition.The witches predict a great future for him.The man's ambition and lust for power awaken, additionally fueled by his wife.However, his path to the throne will be bloody.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: The year is 1961. Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan (Timothée Chalamet) from Minnesota visits his idol - folk singer Woody Guthrie (Scoot McNairy) in the hospital.The artist suffering from Huntington's disease is cared for by his friend, Pete Seeger (Edward Norton).An aspiring musician has the opportunity to present one of his songs to experienced performers.They notice his talent.Thanks to the recommendation of a scene veteran, Dylan begins performing in New York folk clubs.On his way, he meets, among others, Joan Baez (Monica Barbaro), with whom he begins cooperation and, over time, also a romance.An aura of mystery, charisma and talent lead him to the peak of popularity.The breakthrough in his career was his performance at the Newport Folk Festival in 1965.The story of the life of a music icon.The director focused on the years 1961-1965.The film received eight Oscar nominations.Actors competing for the statuette included Timothée Chalamet, Edward Norton and Monica Barbaro.

programme.title: Den sidste viking
programme.desc: After fourteen years of imprisonment, Anker (Nikolaj Lie Kaas) is released from prison and has only one goal: to recover the loot from the last robbery.The problem is that the fortune was hidden by his brother Manfred (Mads Mikkelsen), who today introduces himself as John Lennon and suffers from a mental illness.His older sister Freja (Bodil Jorgensen) takes care of him.For the impulsive Anker, his relative's fragile psyche is a minefield and the only way to get his money back.Looking for the key to unlocking his brother's memories, the man starts cooperation with Lothar (Lars Brygmann), whom he met in the hospital, who proposes an unusual experiment to him.With the help of a team of strange characters, they reactivate the legendary band The Beatles... A full of absurdities, a reckless ride through the past, fractured psyche, brotherly loyalty and a world where logic no longer applies.Oscar-winning director Anders Thomas Jensen proves once again that, together with Mads Mikkelsen, he creates cult films.

programme.title: Insomnia
programme.desc: It's a polar summer in northern Alaska.Do miasteczka Nightmute przyjeżdża policjant Will Dormer (Al Pacino) wraz ze swoim partnerem Hapem Eckhartem (Martin Donovan).Mężczyźni mają odnaleźć sprawcę zabójstwa siedemnastoletniej dziewczyny.Will doesn't feel comfortable up north.The polar summer deepens his insomnia.Trop prowadzi do pisarza Waltera Fincha (Robin Williams), który przyjaźnił się z ofiarą.Podczas pościgu za nim w gęstej mgle Will strzela do partnera.Hap dies.W ostatnich słowach oskarża Willa, że zrobił to, by uniemożliwić wewnętrzne śledztwo.Dormer zaciera ślady, kierując podejrzenia na Fincha.Pisarz, który był świadkiem zabójstwa Hapa, zaczyna szantażować Willa.Tymczasem miejscowa policjantka, Ellie Burr (Hilary Swank), jest coraz bliżej odkrycia prawdy o śmierci Hapa.

programme.title: 28 Days Later...
programme.desc: W jednym z laboratoriów w Wielkiej Brytanii został wyhodowany zabójczy wirus.Grupa obrońców zwierząt wdziera się tam i uwalnia małpy, na których prowadzono badania.Oszalałe z wściekłości zwierzęta rzucają się na swoich wybawców.Zainfekowana osoba w ciągu 12 sekund traci panowanie nad sobą i staje się żądną krwi bestią.Epidemia niezwykle szybko rozprzestrzenia się na cały kraj.28 dni później leżący na oddziale intensywnej terapii w jednym z londyńskich szpitali Jim (Cillian Murphy) budzi się ze śpiączki.Nie rozumiejąc, co się stało, błąka się po opustoszałych ulicach miasta.Przerażonego mężczyznę atakują gromady rozwścieczonych ludzi.Z opresji ratują go Selena (Naomie Harris) i Mark (Noah Huntley).Wszyscy troje uciekają z miasta i trafiają do bazy wojskowej dowodzonej przez majora Henry'ego Westa (Christopher Eccleston).However, they are not safe there either.

programme.title: Ghostlight
programme.desc: Grieving construction worker Dan (Keith Kupferer) joins a local theater group working on a production of Romeo and Juliet.W jego życiu zachodzą zmiany.

programme.title: Robot Dreams
programme.desc: A lonely and timid Dog lives in colorful, bustling New York.Nieufny barykaduje się w swoim mieszkaniu i z żalem patrzy na gwarne miasto.The cure for his fears turns out to be a Robot, which the pet orders under the influence of an advertisement.When the parcel arrives, the dog assembles the sent model.Ten ożywa i od razu staje się najlepszym kumplem psa.From then on, the friends spend fun-filled days together.Chodzą na wrotki, jedzą hot-dogi, słuchają muzyki i spacerują ulicami metropolii.They are inseparable.However, their happy life together ends with a trip to the beach.Bathing in the sea has a tragic ending for Robot - he cannot move and has to stay in a sandy, closed area.Zrozpaczony Pies nie jest w stanie sam go przenieść.Robi jednak wszystko, by go stamtąd wyciągnąć.Once again he must overcome his fear of the world.His immobilized friend also dreams of the day when they will finally meet again.An Oscar-nominated animation based on a comic book by Sara Varon.

programme.title: A Royal Affair
programme.desc: 18th century.The young English aristocrat Caroline Matilda of Hanover (Alicia Vikander) marries the Danish king Christian VII (Mikkel Boe Folsgaard) as part of a political alliance.A smart, well-read and beautiful girl tries to cope with her new role.However, she finds no happiness with her exalted husband who shows signs of mental illness.When the German doctor Johann Friedrich Struensee (Mads Mikkelsen), whom the monarch has absolute trust in, appears at the court, the royal wife treats him with reluctance.Over time, however, she discovers how much she has in common with a progressive doctor, a follower of the ideas of the Enlightenment and a liberal who read the books of Voltaire, Rousseau and Locke.The two begin a passionate affair.Struensee gains more and more power and, with the support of Karolina Matilda, carries out innovative reforms.He makes many enemies.The court dignitaries, who have so far manipulated the king, do not intend to accept the loss of influence.They plot to get rid of the queen's lover.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Hal Porterfield (Christopher Abbott) orders room service at a posh hotel.Rebecca Marin (Margaret Qualley) shows up at the apartment to interview him for the position of general manager of this chain of facilities.Her questions become more and more personal and lead to a surprising ending.In reality, the woman is a dominatrix who follows the script prepared by Hal.However, the relationship does not follow the script ordered by the client.The woman decides to blackmail the rich man.She claims that she recorded a compromising sex tape with him.

credits.actor: Man in the Hallway - Francisco Castaneda
Woman in the Hallway - Kathie Young

programme.title: The Front Runner
programme.desc: Senator Gary Hart (Hugh Jackman) is extremely popular, especially among younger voters.In 1988, he decided to run for the presidency of the United States for the second time.He is considered by many to be the favorite.However, unexpectedly, his extramarital relationship with Donna Rice (Sara Paxton) comes to light.The media is publicizing this case, and Hart's career is in question... The director and screenwriter of the film, Jason Reitman, was nominated for the Festival Award at the Toronto International Film Festival.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Dark-skinned Percy (Bernie Mac) is the head of the Jones family and always knows what is best for his loved ones.He also has an opinion on what the future husband of his daughter, Theresa (Zoe Saldana), should be like.Unfortunately, so far none of her admirers have gained his recognition.When Theresa tells him about her new boyfriend, stockbroker Simon (Ashton Kutcher), her father finally seems to support her choice.However, at the first meeting, the good impression disappears.It turns out that Simon is... white.In addition, she does not ask Percy for her daughter's hand in marriage because he has already proposed to her.What's more, he wants to announce his engagement at the silver wedding of his future in-laws.Percy decides to make his daughter give up the marriage on her own.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: The year is 1961. Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan (Timothée Chalamet) from Minnesota visits his idol - folk singer Woody Guthrie (Scoot McNairy) in the hospital.The artist suffering from Huntington's disease is cared for by his friend, Pete Seeger (Edward Norton).An aspiring musician has the opportunity to present one of his songs to experienced performers.They notice his talent.Thanks to the recommendation of a scene veteran, Dylan begins performing in New York folk clubs.On his way, he meets, among others, Joan Baez (Monica Barbaro), with whom he begins cooperation and, over time, also a romance.An aura of mystery, charisma and talent lead him to the peak of popularity.The breakthrough in his career was his performance at the Newport Folk Festival in 1965.The story of the life of a music icon.The director focused on the years 1961-1965.The film received eight Oscar nominations.Actors competing for the statuette included Timothée Chalamet, Edward Norton and Monica Barbaro.

programme.title: Ford v Ferrari
programme.desc: The victory in the prestigious race goes to the Ferrari team every year.Henry Ford II intends to dethrone the full-time champion.He thinks about building a car that will leave the competition behind.For this purpose, he asks for help from two specialists.One of them is the temperamental fast driving enthusiast Ken Miles.The second one is Carroll Shelby, who can boast of winning Le Mans, and some time ago, due to health problems, he gave up his driving career and took up car design.They both immediately take up the challenge, even though they know that there is a long way to achieve their goal.They quickly encounter resistance from officials.It turns out that they must immerse themselves in the world of ruthless bureaucracy to take part in the twenty-four-hour race.

programme.title: Lord Of The Flies
programme.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programme.title: Materialists
programme.desc: Lucy (Dakota Johnson), an employee of a luxury dating agency, measures her professional success by having nine arranged marriages.Together with her colleagues, she recruits clients based on their market value, which is determined by financial status, education and age.She follows a similar logic herself.She ended her five-year relationship because her boyfriend John (Chris Evans) had too little income.Now she is single and waiting for a rich man whom she will quickly marry.Fate sends her Harry (Pedro Pascal), the owner of an apartment worth... 12 million dollars.A relationship with him, even without love, becomes a beneficial investment for her and a guarantee of a high standard of living.But then John appears on the horizon again and, against her better judgment, Lucy begins to have doubts...

programme.title: Manodrome
programme.desc: Ralphie (Jesse Eisenberg) recently lost his job.He barely makes ends meet by moonlighting as an Uber driver, while his partner Sal (Odessa Young) is about to give birth.Ralphie is not prepared for his new role, and his problems make it difficult for him to control his emotions.Seeing his helplessness and growing frustration, his gym friend Jason introduces him to the charismatic Dan (Adrien Brody), the leader of a mysterious group of celibate men who preach patriarchy.Ralphie, in crisis, is drawn into their world.Over time, he develops a dangerous obsession.

programme.title: Miami Vice
programme.desc: Police officers Sonny Crockett and Ricardo Tubbs are assigned to a dangerous mission.They are busting a gang of drug smugglers, led by a man named Montoya.The trafficker is believed to be involved in the murder of two federal agents and the family of their informant.Crockett and Tubbs infiltrate the Montoi organization.Sonny begins an affair with Isabella, who invests the proceeds of crime in legal ventures.Crockett tries to protect his lover, having no idea what the woman actually does and what her true identity is.Meanwhile, Tubbs and his girlfriend, analyst Trudy Joplin, try to understand the activities of criminals using their own methods.Ricardo does not know that he is putting his beloved in danger.Wanting to reach the gang leader, two detectives decide to transport a load of drugs to southern Florida.Gradually, the lines between the rules of the underworld and the rule of law are blurring.

programme.title: 28 weeks later
programme.desc: The virus spreading throughout Great Britain, which triggered murderous instincts in people, devastated the entire country.28 weeks later, the authorities decide to repopulate the deserted areas.Settlers are brought to a closely guarded part of London.Among them are Don Harris (Robert Carlyle) and his teenage children, Andy (Mackintosh Muggleton) and Tammy (Imogen Poots).The siblings sneak out at night to a destroyed part of the city.They find their mother (Catherine McCormack) there and decide to bring her to the base.

programme.title: Living
programme.desc: London, 1953. Rodney Williams (Bill Nighy) has been doing the same boring bureaucratic job for years.A lonely man feels that his life has been meaningless for a long time.One day he learns from the doctor that he has been diagnosed with incurable cancer.Desperate, he goes to a seaside town to commit suicide.However, he changes his mind and spends the night wandering around bars with a writer he meets there, Sutherland (Tom Burke).Back in London, Williams doesn't go to the office.He runs into Margaret Harris (Aimee Lou Wood), a much younger and energetic woman who once worked in his department.He becomes friends with her and she infects him with her enthusiasm.When the man's condition worsens, he decides to do something important.With the help of Peter Wakeling (Alex Sharp), a young idealist from his office, he wants to build a playground, the construction of which he himself had previously blocked.A remake of "The Brand of Death", a drama by Akira Kurosawa, inspired by Leo Tolstoy's short story "The Death of Ivan Ilyich".

programme.title: Christmas In The Spotlight
programme.desc: The singer and the football player start dating before Christmas.The public is following the development of their relationship with interest.The couple must decide whether the affair will turn into a lasting relationship.

programme.title: Goodbye, Christopher Robin
programme.desc: End of World War I.A.A.Milne (Domhnall Gleeson) moves to the countryside with his family and, finding inspiration in the toys of his son Christopher Robin (Will Tilston), creates a story about the adventures of Winnie the Pooh, who will soon become a children's favorite.However, the quickly achieved international success is not only about profits.The price of A.A.'s fameMilne will suffer not only himself, but also his wife Daphne (Margot Robbie), their son and his caregiver Olive (Kelly Macdonald).The moving film with biographical elements received a BIFA nomination for best supporting actress - Kelly Macdonald.The music composed by Carter Burwell was appreciated by the World Academy of Film Music.

credits.actor: Christopher Robin Aged 6 Months - Stanley Hamlin

programme.title: Gli addestratori
programme.desc: A somewhat clumsy but passionate dog trainer, Pasquale Marolla (Pasquale Petrolo), dreams of opening his own training center for dogs.Unfortunately, he loses the competition and a bet with his ex-wife, Marta (Geppi Cucciari), which causes the woman to take away his beloved pet, the border collie Cecchino.To get money and prove to the woman that he is enterprising, the man advertises a summer course for dogs.He is very surprised when he discovers that, as a result of a mistake, instead of pets, several children come to him.At first he can't cope with them, but then he comes up with a clever idea.Over time, the entire group begins to form an extraordinary bond, and through laughter and shared challenges, both Pasquale and the children learn true values: friendship, respect and sensitivity.

programme.title: The Book of Life
programme.desc: Two powerful magicians bet whether people are pure in heart.La Muerte is the ruler of the World of the Remembered.The dead stay there, remaining in the hearts of their loved ones.Xibalba rules the Land of the Forgotten - a sad place for souls that no one remembers.The magicians are tested by: fashion matador Manolo, who dreams of being a musician, and Joaquin - an athlete and the pride of the city.The boys compete for the affections of Maria, the daughter of the local mayor.However, the beautiful bride is resistant to their advances.Manolo and Joaquin will go on a wonderful journey, during which they will visit extraordinary lands, meet colorful characters and discover the truth about themselves.The project by Guillermo del Toro and Jorge R. Gutierrez was nominated for a Golden Globe in the category of best animated film.

programme.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programme.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programme.title: Druk
programme.desc: Denmark.Martin, Tommy, Peter and Nikolaj work as middle school teachers.They are burnt out and everyday life is taking its toll on them.During Nikolaj's birthday party, the men discuss the theory that people are born with an alcohol deficit.Its small dose - only half a per mille in the blood - is supposed to increase their overall satisfaction.They decide to test it themselves and be excited every day.They quickly notice the positive effects - their family relationships improve, and they start to do better at work.Martin is finally able to communicate with his wife Anika and children, and the students finally listen to him with interest.Over time, however, it turns out that the initial dose is no longer enough for my friends and they start increasing it.They find that everything has its price.

Rodney Williams (Bill Nighy) has been doing the same boring bureaucratic job for years.A lonely man feels that his life has been meaningless for a long time.One day he learns from the doctor that he has been diagnosed with incurable cancer.Desperate, he goes to a seaside town to commit suicide.However, he changes his mind and spends the night wandering around bars with a writer he meets there, Sutherland (Tom Burke).Back in London, Williams doesn't go to the office.He runs into Margaret Harris (Aimee Lou Wood), a much younger and energetic woman who once worked in his department.He becomes friends with her and she infects him with her enthusiasm.When the man's condition worsens, he decides to do something important.With the help of Peter Wakeling (Alex Sharp), a young idealist from his office, he wants to build a playground, the construction of which he himself had previously blocked.A remake of "The Brand of Death", a drama by Akira Kurosawa, inspired by Leo Tolstoy's short story "The Death of Ivan Ilyich".

programme.title: The Other Guys
programme.desc: Hot-tempered New York detective Terry Hoitz (Mark Wahlberg) dreams of his name going down in police history.Unfortunately, he is punitively delegated to office work.His dim-witted partner Allen Gamble (Will Ferrell) is not keen on catching criminals and would rather spend his days behind a desk.As a result, those with completely opposite characters do not like each other.However, both of them share a feeling of inferiority because they are still in the shadow of the local police celebrities: P.K.Highsmith (Samuel L. Jackson) and Christopher Danson (Dwayne Johnson).The opportunity to take their place comes sooner than they might expect.When the famous duo is killed in action, Terry and Allen face the opportunity of a lifetime.They are on the trail of a scandal involving multimillionaire David Ershon (Steve Coogan).If they manage to find evidence of a crime and catch the culprits, they will gain recognition and decorations.However, if they fail, they will face professional degradation.

credits.actor: reporter na konferencji prasowej - Andrew Secunda

programme.title: River Wild
programme.desc: Idaho.Doctor Joey (Leighton Meester) goes to meet Brother Gray (Taran Killam), who is organizing a rafting trip on the Salmon River.There he meets his long-time friend Trevor (Adam Brody), who is on parole, and two young women.Initially, the rafting takes place in a relaxed atmosphere.Everything changes on their first night together, when the kayakers set up camp.One of the young women suffers serious injuries.The circumstances of the incident are unclear, and the injured party herself claims that she was the victim of an attack.The incident disturbs the peace of Joey and the other participants of the expedition.However, it turns out that this is only the beginning of the problems.

programme.title: 4 from there
programme.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.
